classical_baseline: The paper compares against classical computers as the baseline for exact solution finding, and also discusses prior variational quantum algorithms such as HEA and QAOA as the main state-of-the-art methods for constrained binary optimization. It specifically names penalty-term-based QAOA, commute-Hamiltonian-based QAOA, and hardware-efficient ansatz as prior approaches.
classical_baseline_quotes: The VQAs for constrained binary optimization can be categorized into hardware-efficient ansatz (HEA) [24], and quantum approx- imate optimization algorithm (QAOA) [15, 41, 44].
extraction_notes: Motivation is explicit in abstract and introduction; finance mention is generic rather than portfolio-specific.
